# AI Hardware Advisor

> A Sanity knowledge base (laws/formulas, rules, solution paths, run reports) that answers "what computer do I need
> to run this AI model — or should I keep, upgrade or rent?" and recomputes the agent's math with its own formulas.

- [Agent setup + how to use](https://hw-advisor.helgardorlm.tech/setup.md): read and follow this first.
- [Context: instructions + schema](https://hw-advisor.helgardorlm.tech/api/context)
- Query: https://hw-advisor.helgardorlm.tech/api/query?q=<URL-encoded GROQ>
- Check a draft answer: POST JSON {answer, searched_web} to https://hw-advisor.helgardorlm.tech/api/check
- GET-only agents: send the draft in ~1500-char pieces with /api/part?draft=<random id>&n=1&text=<URL-encoded>, n=2, …, then /api/check?draft=<id>&searched_web=true|false (checks the whole joined draft)
- MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP, no auth): https://hw-advisor.helgardorlm.tech/mcp
- [Skill file](https://hw-advisor.helgardorlm.tech/SKILL.md)
